title: trackerAttachmentDocumentBytes
responsibility: Defines what an attached document may contain and measures the bytes it costs.

inputs.name: trackerAttachmentDocumentBytes.document
inputs.description: The markdown and any images as data addresses.

outputs.name: trackerAttachmentDocumentSchema
outputs.description: Accepts bounded non-empty markdown and images that are base64 PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or SVG data addresses.

outputs.name: trackerAttachmentDocumentBytes
outputs.description: UTF-8 bytes of the markdown plus the length of every image data address.
